title: depthcheck: depth-computable component of the single-cell Fano factor
description:
depthcheck decomposes the Fano factor of normalized single-cell UMI counts into a term that depends only on per-cell library sizes and a gene-specific residual, and returns a pre-registered verdict on whether a between-group contrast can be read as a difference in transcriptional noise.

The decomposition is an identity: F_g = K E[1/L] + K D_g, hence Delta F_g = K Delta E[1/L] + K Delta D_g. The first term is computable from library sizes alone.

This deposit contains the version described in the manuscript: the Python package, its test suite, the vignette, and the scripts that reproduce the application numbers.
